headlines.officialText: The Federal Open Market Committee approved the following statement for release by a 12 – 0 vote: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate. Economic activity is expanding at a solid pace. Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little. Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal.
